svg.title: Разведение рук у стены — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Wall angel shoulder mobility. Front oblique view with clear vertical wall plane behind shoulders, back against wall, feet planted. LEFT elbows bent 90 degrees with upper arms angled down at sides in W position, backs of hands near wall. RIGHT slide both arms up into overhead Y position, backs of hands follow wall. Same wall and same feet in both phases. Empty hands. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
